audience: teams that track time on projects and tasks in Beebole

useCases.title: Review hours logged on a project
useCases.text: List time records for a date window of up to 366 days, with their projects and durations.

useCases.title: Find project and task ids
useCases.text: List projects and tasks with their ids, so you can log time against the right one.

useCases.title: Log a day's work
useCases.text: Read your own person id, then create one time record with a start time, a duration in minutes and an optional task and comment.

useCases.title: Correct a time record
useCases.text: Change the duration or the comment of an existing time record. A new duration overwrites the logged value.

useCases.title: Check who is on the team
useCases.text: List the people and the tags of the account, with their ids and names.
